name: dsh-verified
description: Execution-verified plugin reports for DeepSeek Harness — install it, load it, run it, measure it.
//: Zero dependencies, on purpose: the CLI runs straight from TypeScript via
Node 24's native type stripping, so there is no build step and no
node_modules. `private` is deliberate — publishing to npm is a maintainer
decision, not something this project does on its own. Until then the
command runs from a checkout: `npm exec -- dsh-verified static <spec>`,
